constraints: Use WEB Get body part count first to learn how many parts are available to parse.
For file parts, contents must be captured into a Blob; for plain Text form fields submitted in a multi-part request, contents can be captured into Text.
_needsReview: Description text says '"mimeType and name are optional but must be passed together"', but the signature's actual trailing params are name (input-field name) then mimeType then fileName -- 'name' here plausibly means fileName (the doc reuses 'name' loosely for both the input-field name and the original file name). Modeled the joint-optionality as mimeType+fileName (the more literal reading of 'name of the original file'); could instead be mimeType+name if the doc meant the input-field name param. Please verify against the live doc page.

jointConstraints.rule: Optional together: when the part is a submitted file both are received; otherwise both are absent.

params.name: part
params.description: Number of the part to be parsed.

params.name: contents
params.description: Contents of the part (Blob for files, Text for submitted text fields).

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the HTTP input field (variable name).

params.name: mimeType
params.description: Mime type of the submitted file, if any; only present when the part was submitted as a file.

params.name: fileName
params.description: Name of the submitted file, if any; only present when the part was submitted as a file.
